module: luamqtt implementation of the MQTT 5.0 protocol: packet construction (make_packet) and parsing (parse_packet), with properties and user properties, reason codes and the AUTH packet. Loaded by client.lua when version 5 is requested.

make_packet.desc: Builds an MQTT 5 packet from an arguments table whose type field is a packet_type; handles properties and user_properties.

returns.desc: Combined packet ready to send, or false and an error message.

parse_packet.desc: Parses a received MQTT 5 packet using read_func.

returns.desc: Parsed packet, or false and an error message.
